key_insight: FrugalEvo makes LLM-guided program evolution cost-aware by pairing a strong planner LLM with a cheaper code-refinement LLM and optimizing performance per dollar via BA-AUC.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical template for lower-cost automated algorithm discovery and tuning, especially when compute/API budget matters more than raw iteration count.
method: Use a higher-cost LLM to explore and propose solution strategies.
Use a cheaper LLM to implement, refine, and continue evolving code.
Maximize cache reuse with prefix-sharing prompts and harness design; track progress with BA-AUC over cumulative cost.
evidence_signal: Across 10 mathematical and systems optimization tasks and 10 ALE-Bench-Lite tasks, FrugalEvo matched or beat strong baselines in final quality and achieved higher BA-AUC on 9 tasks, including new SOTA on circle packing at very low cost.
watch_item: Results depend on careful prompt/harness engineering and LLM cost assumptions, so gains may vary across tasks, model choices, and caching setups.
paper_title: FrugalEvo: Towards Cost-Aware LLM-Guided Program Evolution
